# Kuailu HR | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Typical flow |
| --- | --- |
| New-hire onboarding | Interview & Offer approval → Pending Onboarding → onboarding confirmation → employee roster, attendance profile and compensation profile creation |
| Attendance administration | Configure attendance group and shift → schedule employees → capture punch / leave / overtime data → review reports |
| Payroll processing | Maintain compensation profile → configure payroll template and rules → retrieve attendance and related inputs → calculate, approve and distribute payslips |
| Employee lifecycle change | Submit regularization, transfer or offboarding form → approval → write back employee, attendance and compensation records |
| Multi-site / shift workforce | Use group scope, shift scheduling, leave quotas and raw attendance records to coordinate employees across departments or locations |
